# System Architecture

## SECTION 1 — Component / Module / Role Table

| Component | Module | Role |
|-----------|--------|------|
| IterativeTDDRunner | `src.agents.iterative_tdd_runner.IterativeTDDRunner` | Orchestrates the RED→GREEN→REFACTOR loop across multiple cycles |
| TDDCycleRunner | `src.agents.tdd_cycle_runner.TDDCycleRunner` | Executes a single TDD cycle with GREEN retries and learning |
| IncrementalPlanner | `src.agents.incremental_planner.IncrementalPlanner` | Determines the next test increment based on feature requirements |
| PythonLanguagePod | `src.agents.python_language_pod.PythonLanguagePod` | LanguagePod for Python: code generation + container execution |
| GoLanguagePod | `src.agents.go_language_pod.GoLanguagePod` | LanguagePod for Go: code generation + container execution |
| TypeScriptLanguagePod | `src.agents.typescript_language_pod.TypeScriptLanguagePod` | LanguagePod for TypeScript: code generation + container execution |
| WorkerAgent | `src.agents.worker_agent.WorkerAgent` | Generates code for RED, GREEN, REFACTOR phases using LLM |
| TypeScriptWorkerAgent | `src.agents.typescript_worker_agent.TypeScriptWorkerAgent` | TypeScript-specific code generation delegate |
| PodmanOrchestrator | `src.agents.podman_orchestrator.PodmanOrchestrator` | Stateless sidecar that runs code in a sandboxed container |
| PodmanRunner | `src.agents.podman_runner.PodmanRunner` | Rootless Podman container lifecycle manager |
| GoRunner | `src.agents.go_runner.GoRunner` | PodmanRunner pre-configured for Go harness |
| TypeScriptRunner | `src.agents.typescript_runner.TypeScriptRunner` | PodmanRunner pre-configured for TypeScript harness |
| PlaybookManager | `src.playbook.manager.PlaybookManager` | CRUD operations for playbook bullets with deduplication |
| BulletRetriever | `src.playbook.retrieval.BulletRetriever` | Hybrid retrieval of relevant bullets for a query |
| ContextGraphRetriever | `src.retrieval.cgr3_retriever.ContextGraphRetriever` | CGR³: context-aware retrieve-rank-reason pipeline |
| ContextScorer | `src.retrieval.context_scorer.ContextScorer` | Scores bullets against request context (temporal, team, tech) |
| InstitutionalKnowledgeService | `src.retrieval.service.InstitutionalKnowledgeService` | Central knowledge retrieval for all code generation |
| Generator | `src.core.generator.module.Generator` | Generates task solutions using playbook context |
| Reflector | `src.core.reflector.module.Reflector` | Analyzes execution outcomes and extracts learning insights |
| Curator | `src.core.curator.module.Curator` | Synthesizes insights into playbook delta bullets |
| ExperimentLogger | `src.storage.experiment_logger.ExperimentLogger` | Persists TDD cycles and ML experiments to DB |
| LLMClient | `src.utils.llm_client.LLMClient` | Unified interface across multiple LLM providers |
| EnsembleBuildRunner | `src.agents.ensemble_build.EnsembleBuildRunner` | Multi-candidate blind build for one feature |
| GherkinExtractionAgent | `src.agents.gherkin_extraction_agent.GherkinExtractionAgent` | Reverse-engineers Gherkin from existing code and tests |
| GherkinFeatureBridge | `src.agents.gherkin_feature_bridge.GherkinFeatureBridge` | Parses .feature file into FeatureSpec |
| TestReviewAgent | `src.agents.test_review_agent.TestReviewAgent` | Validates test quality before implementation |
| ImportFilter | `src.agents.import_filter.ImportFilter` | Blocks forbidden imports and builtins in generated code |
| RedundancyPreChecker | `src.agents.redundancy_checker.RedundancyPreChecker` | Detects redundant tests before writing them |
| PerformanceAggregator | `src.broker.performance_aggregator.PerformanceAggregator` | Extracts agent metrics from audit trail |
| AdaptiveBroker | `src.broker.adaptive_broker.AdaptiveBroker` | Routes tasks to best agent based on performance history |
| ModelAttributionTracker | `src.benchmark.model_attribution.ModelAttributionTracker` | Tracks OpenRouter model attribution in performance metrics |
| AuditStore | `src.audit.store.AuditStore` | Append-only hash-chained audit event store |
| LocalAuditClient | `src.audit.local_client.LocalAuditClient` | Write-only audit client for local SQLite |
| PlaybookEnforcer | `src.utils.playbook_enforcer.PlaybookEnforcer` | Enforces playbook rules like high-frequency feedback |

## SECTION 2 — Core Data Flow Sequence Diagram

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Runner as IterativeTDDRunner
    participant Planner as IncrementalPlanner
    participant Cycle as TDDCycleRunner
    participant Pod as PythonLanguagePod
    participant Worker as WorkerAgent
    participant LLM as LLMClient
    participant Orch as PodmanOrchestrator
    participant Cont as PodmanRunner
    participant Playbook as PlaybookManager
    participant Reflector as Reflector
    participant Curator as Curator
    participant Logger as ExperimentLogger
    participant Audit as AuditClient

    Runner->>Planner: next_increment(requirement, cycle)
    activate Planner
    Planner-->>Runner: PodSpec
    deactivate Planner

    loop For each cycle
        Runner->>Cycle: run(spec)
        activate Cycle

        Note over Cycle: RED phase
        Cycle->>Pod: run_red(spec)
        activate Pod
        Pod->>Worker: generate_test(spec)
        activate Worker
        Worker->>LLM: generate(prompt)
        activate LLM
        LLM-->>Worker: code
        deactivate LLM
        Worker-->>Pod: test_code
        deactivate Worker
        Pod->>Orch: pulse({test_file: code})
        activate Orch
        Orch->>Cont: send_pulse(files)
        activate Cont
        Cont-->>Orch: PhaseResult
        deactivate Cont
        Orch-->>Pod: PhaseResult
        deactivate Orch
        alt abort or never pulsed
            Pod-->>Cycle: PhaseResult(error)
            Cycle-->>Runner: CycleResult(fail)
            deactivate Pod
            deactivate Cycle
            Note right of Runner: Exit cycle loop
        else test file written
            Pod-->>Cycle: PhaseResult(passed=False)
            deactivate Pod
            Cycle->>Audit: emit(TEST_GENERATED)
        end

        Note over Cycle: GREEN phase (with retries)
        loop up to max_green_attempts
            Cycle->>Pod: run_green(spec)
            activate Pod
            Pod->>Worker: generate_implementation(spec, error_feedback)
            activate Worker
            Worker->>LLM: generate(prompt)
            activate LLM
            LLM-->>Worker: code
            deactivate LLM
            Worker-->>Pod: impl_code
            deactivate Worker
            Pod->>Orch: pulse({test_file, impl_file})
            activate Orch
            Orch->>Cont: send_pulse(files)
            activate Cont
            Cont-->>Orch: PhaseResult
            deactivate Cont
            Orch-->>Pod: PhaseResult
            deactivate Orch
            Pod-->>Cycle: PhaseResult
            deactivate Pod
            alt passed or abort
                break
            else failed
                Cycle->>Cycle: update error_feedback
            end
        end

        alt green failed
            Cycle-->>Runner: CycleResult(fail)
            deactivate Cycle
            Note right of Runner: Cycle unrecoverable
        else green passed
            Cycle->>Audit: emit(IMPLEMENTATION_GENERATED)

            Note over Cycle: REFACTOR phase
            Cycle->>Pod: run_refactor(spec)
            activate Pod
            Pod->>Worker: generate_refactor(spec)
            activate Worker
            Worker->>LLM: generate(prompt)
            activate LLM
            LLM-->>Worker: refactored_code
            deactivate LLM
            Worker-->>Pod: refactored_code
            deactivate Worker
            Pod->>Orch: pulse({test_file, impl_file})
            activate Orch
            Orch->>Cont: send_pulse(files)
            activate Cont
            Cont-->>Orch: PhaseResult
            deactivate Cont
            Orch-->>Pod: PhaseResult
            deactivate Orch
            Pod-->>Cycle: PhaseResult
            deactivate Pod

            Note over Cycle: Learning loop
            Cycle->>Reflector: reflect(task, gen_output, env_feedback)
            activate Reflector
            Reflector->>LLM: analyze prompt
            activate LLM
            LLM-->>Reflector: analysis
            deactivate LLM
            Reflector-->>Cycle: ReflectorOutput
            deactivate Reflector

            Cycle->>Curator: curate(reflector_output, playbook_id)
            activate Curator
            Curator->>LLM: synthesis prompt
            activate LLM
            LLM-->>Curator: delta bullets
            deactivate LLM
            Curator->>Playbook: apply_delta(delta_bullets)
            activate Playbook
            Playbook-->>Curator: added_bullets
            deactivate Playbook
            Curator-->>Cycle: CuratorOutput
            deactivate Curator

            Cycle->>Audit: emit(PATTERN_LEARNED, CYCLE_COMPLETED)
            Cycle->>Logger: log_tdd_cycle(...)
            activate Logger
            Logger-->>Cycle: logged
            deactivate Logger

            Cycle-->>Runner: CycleResult(success)
        end
        deactivate Cycle
    end

    Runner->>Audit: emit(CYCLE_COMPLETED) for final
```
